name: Ophthalmology / eye specialists (category guide)
summary: Optometrist vs ophthalmologist triage — SNEC foreigner fees, private dry-eye upsells, and when red-eye needs a medical specialist not a new pair of glasses.
body: Mall optometry fixes refraction; ophthalmology treats disease (cornea, retina, glaucoma, persistent red-eye, sudden vision change). Forum dry-eye threads repeatedly warn that lubricants alone may stall while blepharitis or meibomian disease needs a medical eye doctor — SNEC / public pathways are slower for foreigners paying full fees, so private specialists buy calendar speed, not subsidy. Ask SMC Ophthalmology registration, which hospital the doctor operates at, and whether IPL / punctal-plug packages are diagnosis-led or brochure-led. Corporate outpatient riders often reimburse specialist consults only with GP referral and may carve ‘vision correction’ differently from medical eye disease — read the schedule before a scan deposit. Distinct from optical / optometry category listings. This is a category guide, not a ranked eye-surgeon list.
